entities.name: Karim García
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gustavo Karim García Aguayo is a Mexican former professional baseball right fielder who currently serves as the manager for the Tigres de Quintana Roo of the Mexican League. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) from 1995 to 2004 for the Los Angeles Dodgers, Arizona Diamondbacks, Detroit Tigers, Baltimore Orioles, Cleveland Indians, New York Yankees, and New York Mets. He also played in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Orix Buffaloes, and in the KBO League for the Lotte Giants and Hanwha Eagles. García bats and throws left-handed.
